_comment: This repository's CatHarness instance DECLARATION. Renamed from `harness.json` on 2026-09-26: platform main composes both filenames from the instance's own name (`instanceDeclarationFilename(name) = <name>.json`, `instanceConfigFilename(name) = <name>.config.json` in cat-harness/schemas/cat-harness.ts), and `findDeclarationFile` accepts a file ONLY when its filename stem equals its own `name` field. Stem `harness` against name `qou` failed that test -- the platform's own words for the state are 'the rename-half-done case check:instance-config already reports'. Stem `qou` now agrees. Paired with `qou.config.json` (what this instance IS); this file is WHERE its tree is.
name: qou
description: Quantum Observable Universe — a framework for quantum physics via rigid monoidal categories

directories._graphKinds_comment: RENAMED from `graphs` 2026-09-26. Platform main renamed this field on 2026-09-21 and the old name was the conflation it fixes: `graphs: ["folio"]` read literally asserts this directory IS the folio graph, when what is meant is that the graph here is OF KIND folio (cat-harness/schemas/cat-harness.ts, GraphNodeDirectoryShape). `graphs` still WORKS -- `acceptLegacyGraphsKey` accepts it where `graphKinds` is absent, and that alias exists precisely for unmigrated downstream folios like this one -- so this is alignment, not a fix for a break. Deliberately not a merge upstream: if both are present `graphKinds` wins, so never carry both.
directories._dependents_comment: `reproduce` because a folio directory is part of the SHAPE a folio has: an instance depending on qou wants its OWN empty tree, not qou's five papers. Same argument as `uploads/` and `library/`. REQUIRED on platform main since folio-assistant #512, where readDeclaration THROWS without it -- that is a statement about MAIN, not about the pin, where nothing reads this file at all.
directories.description: The authored folios: quantum-observable-universe and its siblings, each a directory holding a same-named manifest. NOT `folio/` — see `_comment`.
directories._path_comment: 🛑 DO NOT CHANGE THIS PATH TO `folio/` WITHOUT AN OWNER DECISION -- and note that the previous version of this comment said the opposite. It read: the move is planned as bean qou-yqko and this path changes to `folio/` in the same commit as the move. That was written from the 2026-09-26 instruction alone ('Can move content/ for to folio/ to match. Align to f-asst unless specific reason not to') WITHOUT checking the platform, and the platform is the specific reason not to. Measured at platform main e3264b4: cat-harness/schemas/cat-harness.ts:4557 `folioDir(root)` returns `directoryForGraph(root, 'folio') ?? join(root, 'folio')` -- the DECLARATION WINS and `folio/` is only the fallback -- and cat-harness/schemas/folio-dir.test.ts opens with a test titled 'a folio DECLARING content/ resolves to content/ -- THE QOU CASE', whose comment cites: Owner, 2026-09-20: 'qou can declare a new folio at content/'. That test also records that BEFORE folioDir, 162 sites spelled `join(root, 'folio')` as a literal and this declaration was ignored. So the platform was deliberately changed, six days earlier and on the owner's own instruction, to support exactly this path. Two owner instructions six days apart point opposite ways; today's carries 'unless specific reason not to', and this is one. NOT resolved here -- framed for the owner in bean qou-yqko, which is NOT to be actioned until they choose. Corollary worth knowing: a folio keeping `content/` must SAY so. `folioDir`'s fallback is `folio/` and the platform tests that the fallback is NEVER `content/` ('that root is excised'), so if this declaration stops being readable qou's content becomes invisible rather than defaulting sensibly -- which is what makes the harness.json -> qou.json rename in `_comment` load-bearing rather than cosmetic.

_platform_scope_comment: SCOPE, because the previous wording asserted platform-main behaviour in the present tense and was false of what this repo runs. Measured 2026-09-26 at the PINNED platform df28d02 (.folio-assistant-pin): `readDeclaration` occurs 0 times, `harness.json` 0 times in *.ts, there is no schemas/harness-config.ts and no resolveHarnessConfigPath; src/index.ts:94 reads `folio.config.json`. At platform main (42ccfb38b63) 101 files reference readDeclaration. So THIS FILE IS INERT AT THE PIN and becomes load-bearing only when .folio-assistant-pin moves (bean qou-8321, owner's call). Do not read anything here as a statement about the running system without naming the platform commit.
